description: A night painting of a wooden dhow with a large dark lateen sail, carrying robed and turbaned passengers with small lanterns across choppy dark water under a crescent moon and green-grey clouds. A palm-fringed walled coastal town with a tower sits on the left. The whole painting is enclosed by a thick dark brown wooden picture frame on all four sides, and a small white sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. No letters or numbers, no violence or nudity.
